matches_set.description: Thinksport SPF 50 Zinc Oxide and Titanium Dioxide formula spray rubs in with little to no whitening. Enriched with soothing Aloe and nourishing Vitamin E and Banana Fruit Extract to calm sun-exposed skin so kids stay protected for all day fun in the sun Safety tips: Spray 6-8 inches away from body. Do not spray product directly on face. Spray onto hands and rub onto face. Do not inhale spray. Spray the first layer and rub into skin. With a cleaner, healthier science-led purpose, Think's mission is to create products with unyielding standards for efficacy that support the wellness of our consumers, their families and our global community. Provides healthy, broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection No PABA, parabens, phthalates, oxybenzone, avobenzone, petroleum, dioxane, gluten or dairy. No animal by-products or testing. Does not contain any chemicals known to be harmful to coral reefs. Directions shake well apply liberally and evenly 15 minutes before sun exposure reapply: after 80 minutes of swimming or sweating immediately after towel drying at least every 2 hours Ingredients Active Ingredients: Titanium Dioxide '“ 3.4% Zinc Oxide '“ 15.7% Inactive Ingredients: Water, Butyloctyl Salicyla
